ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the schematic diagram of the spatial structure of a certain city. The urban functional zones of this city include: central business district, wholesale district and light industrial district, low-grade residential district, middle-grade residential district, and high-grade residential district. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the schematic diagram, the various functional zones are not distributed as regular simple concentric circles, but are elongated and extended along several linear channels radiating outward around the central area. The legend shows that these radial linear channels correspond to railway trunk lines, and there are also symbols such as functional zone boundaries. Then reason: the direction in which the functional zones extend outward is consistent with the direction of the railway trunk lines in the diagram, so it can be summarized that the urban functional zones develop outward along transportation trunk lines.

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：示意图中各功能区并不是规则的单纯同心圆分布，而是在中心区周围沿几条向外放射的线状通道被拉长、延伸。图例显示，这些放射状线状通道对应铁路干线，另有功能区界线等符号。再推理：功能区向外伸展的方向与图中铁路干线方向一致，因此可概括为城市功能区沿交通干线向外发展。

planner_metadata.text_role: 题干要求回答“功能区沿什么向外发展”，并给出该图是城市地域功能分区示意图，需要从图中概括发展依托。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 城市功能区若呈放射状、楔形向外扩展，通常是受可达性影响，沿铁路、公路等交通干线扩展；铁路干线属于交通干线。

method.CoT_raw:

再推理：题干列出的中心商务区、批发区与轻工业区、低级住宅区、中级住宅区、高级住宅区，对应典型的城市扇形地域结构。扇形结构的形成主要受交通条件影响，不同功能区常沿主要交通线路由城市中心向外扩展。因此，功能区是沿交通干线向外发展。
